name: rabbit Teach Mode
desc: Rabbit's agent system where you teach a task by performing it once.
desc_zh: rabbit 的智能体系统，你做一遍教会它，之后直接再要一次即可。
solves: Automating a website task used to need code; show the agent how you do it and it repeats the job, adapting small variations.
solves_zh: 自动化一个网站任务原本要写代码；做给智能体看一遍，它就能重复这个活儿，还能适应小变化。
best_for: You file the same expense report every week and would rather demonstrate it once than script it.
best_for_zh: 每周都要报同一张报销单，宁愿演示一遍也不想写脚本时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — rabbit.tech blog and newsroom directories）。 Missing from the ledger. Opened in beta to all R1 users on 2024-11-21. Teach Mode builds on LAM, rabbit's large action model; LAM itself is a model and is not recorded as a product. Teach Mode is a capability inside rabbitOS rather than a separate install. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Teach Mode」，加上品牌名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.rabbit.tech/newsroom/teach-mode-beta 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://www.rabbit.tech/）。
